title: The game is coming to an end, but the surprises are far from over! New episodes of Mom Knows Best? premiere today on Netflix
summary: After following mothers and their children up close and testing how well they know each other, Mom Knows Best? reaches its final stretch.
body_markdown:
São Paulo, September 2, 2026 —


After following mothers and their children up close and testing how well they know each other,


Mom Knows Best?


reaches its final stretch. The second part of the reality show hosted by Claudia Raia premieres today on Netflix, with the final three episodes packed with surprises, new challenges and the final battle for a prize of up to R$ 1 million. Unbeknownst to the children, their mothers were watching them up close throughout, witnessing the decisions they made, how they behaved and what they discovered along the way — getting the chance to discover sides of them they didn't yet know so well. Throughout the competition, the pairs realized that knowing the people you love goes far beyond being familiar with their habits and preferences. Between the things they got right, the things they got wrong and the surprises along the way, the experience led to moments of deep connection and closeness. Now, in the final stretch, new discoveries put that relationship to the test once again, and a major twist promises to completely change the dynamics of the game — while the mothers make their final bets to prove how well they know their children,


the children are about to discover that their mothers were following everything that happened in the competition much more closely than they ever imagined


. And with that revelation, the game takes on new dimensions leading up to the big decision, which could be worth up to R$ 1 million.". Hosted by Claudia Raia and produced by BOXFISH in partnership with Farra,


Mom Knows Best?


turns the relationship between mothers and children into an entertaining and heartfelt competition.


The final episodes of


Mom Knows Best?


are now playing, only on Netflix.


About Netflix


Netflix is one of the world’s leading entertainment services offering TV series, films, games and live programming across a wide variety of genres and languages. Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time.


About BOXFISH


BOXFISH is one of the leading independent production companies currently operating, with offices in Buenos Aires, Madrid, and São Paulo. Founded in 2018 by Diego Guebel, founder of Cuatro Cabezas, the production company behind formats such as CQC, BOXFISH combines experience, creativity, and an international outlook in the development and production of original projects, as well as format adaptations. With a strong presence in entertainment, the company works with some of the market’s leading broadcasters and platforms, including HBO, Netflix, TelevisaUnivision, TV Globo, RecordTV, Amazon Prime, GNT, Telefe, Antena 3 and TVE. Since its launch, BOXFISH has continued to grow, and stands out for its ability to develop distinctive projects with broad appeal and strong international potential.


About Farra


Farra is a Brazilian production company and format creator with a strong presence across streaming, television, branded entertainment, podcasts, film and social media. Founded by executive producer Gui Vieira and writers Gui Cintra and André Brandt — the duo behind original formats such as Mom Knows Best? — the company combines production expertise with the development of innovative content. Over the years, Farra has created, developed and produced projects for major industry players including Netflix, Globo, HBO, Amazon and Paramount.
